# sherpa-callout

A status message box.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | Callout |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-callout/sherpa-callout.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-callout/sherpa-callout.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-callout/sherpa-callout.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-callout/sherpa-callout.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-callout/sherpa-callout.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-callout data-status="warning" data-heading="Heads up">Your trial ends in 3 days.</sherpa-callout>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-dismissible` | boolean |  | show the close button (fires callout-dismiss) |
| `data-heading` | text |  | heading text (rendered into .title) |
| `data-status` | `info` `success` `warning` `critical` `urgent` |  | info \| success \| warning \| critical \| urgent (default: neutral/info) |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `dismiss()` | Dismiss the callout: emit the event and remove the element. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `callout-dismiss` |  |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | content | the message body |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`box`, `close`, `content`, `icon`, `message`, `title`
